svg.aria-label: Jasoos architecture: World ID with IDKit verifies one human per player; 0G Private Computer writes, paints and maps each world; Arkiv stores games, screens, unlocks, sealed accusations and votes.
svg.title: Jasoos architecture
svg.text: 1 · Who is playing? World ID + IDKit
· evidence box = new World ID action
· per case: key opens once per human
· rejected or cancelled: reason, no login
One server wallet 0xf997...83b5 signs every write, one at a time (no nonce clashes)
· project + entityType indexed · expires after 90 days · read in pages of 100
· players see it: gallery, replays, one-accusation rule, vote counts; images live in Vercel Blob
